actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +9 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 22 (3к10+6) колющего урона.
actions.name: Bite

actions.desc:
The giant shark bowl moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the bowl enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. 

On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the bowl. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. 

On a failed save, the bowl enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage at the start of each of the bowl's turns. When the bowl moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. 

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 15 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the bowl.

traits.desc: The giant shark bowl has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy

traits.desc: When the giant shark bowl is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead becomes charged for 1 minute. While charged, its attacks deal an extra 2 (1d4) lightning damage.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Електрикал Чарге». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Electrical Charge

traits.desc: The shark bowl takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but they are subjected to the bowl's Engulf and have disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the bowl can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the bowl can take an action to pull a creature out. Doing so requires a successful DC 15 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. The bowl can hold one Large creature or up to six Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

traits.name: Ooze Fish Bowl

traits.desc: The ooze and the giant shark's life forces have been entwined by an arcane force. They share statistics as if they were one monster and can't be separated.

ru.description: Огромная слизь, мировоззрение: без мировоззрения. Класс доспеха: 6. Хиты: 172 (15к12+75). Скорость: ходьба 20 фт., плавание 20 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 23, ЛОВ 3, ТЕЛ 20, ИНТ 1, МУД 10, ХАР 5. Сопротивление урону: кислотой, огнём, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: электричеством. Иммунитет к состояниям: ослепление, очарование, глухота, истощение, испуг, положение ничком. Чувства: слепое зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 10. Показатель опасности: 8. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 5, действий: 4.
